question: Which of the following plants produce unisexual flowers?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Watermelon and Papaya.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Unisexual flowers** are those that **have male or female reproductive components**, such as stamens or carpels.
 
• Flowers containing pistils are referred to as female flowers, or pistillates, where as those with only stamens are known as male flowers, or staminate flowers.
 
• There is only **cross-pollination** among these flowers.
 
• Examples:
 
 
• **Watermelon**.
 
• **Papaya**.
 
• Cucumber.
 
• Musk melon.
 
• Pumpkin.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• A** bisexual flower** is one that has both male and female reproductive elements, meaning that it has both carpels and stamens.
 
• There is **both self- and cross-pollination** in these flowers.
 
• Examples:
 
 
• **Mustard**.
 
• **Hibiscus**.
 
• Sunflower.
 
• Mango.
 
• Tomato.
